blocks.tamil_translation: is! If (anyone) is wounded in the path of Allah Ta'ala, he will come on the Day of Qiyamah with the wound as fresh as it was; its colour will be the colour of blood, and its fragrance will be the scent of musk. By the One in whose hand is the life of Muhammad ﷺ! Were it not for the fear that it would cause hardship to the Muslims, I would go out with every group that sets out in the path of Allah Ta'ala. But I do not have the means to arrange mounts for everyone, nor do the people have the means for it, and if I went out to battle while the people stayed at home without going with me, it would be a great burden upon them. By the One in whose hand is the life of Muhammad ﷺ! All that I wish is that I should fight in the path of Allah Ta'ala and then be killed, then fight and then be killed, then fight and then be killed.” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ الله ﷺ يَقُولُ: إِذَا تَبَايَعْتُمْ بِالْعِينَةِ وَأَخَذْتُمْ أَذْنَابَ الْبَقَرِ وَرَضِيتُمْ بِالزَّرْعِ وَتَرَكْتُمُ الْجِهَادَ، سَلَّطَ اللهُ عَلَيْكُمْ ذُلًّا لَا يَنْزِعُهُ حَتَّي تَرْجِعُوا إِلي دِينِكُمْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو داؤد، باب في النهي عن العينة، رقم:٣٤٦٢
blocks.tamil_translation: “If you become wholly absorbed in trade and business, and become immersed in farming, holding on to the tails of oxen, and give up striving in the path of Allah, Allah Ta'ala will impose disgrace upon you, and that disgrace will not leave you until you return to the Deen (by doing Jihad in the path of Allah Ta'ala) once again,”
